summary: Clearmind Medicine Inc. filed a Form 6-K on June 18, 2026, attaching a press release announcing the grant of U.S. Patent No. 12,350,242 for its molecule MEAI, covering compositions and methods to regulate binge behaviors. This is a routine intellectual property milestone disclosure by a clinical-stage biotech company. No financial terms, transactions, or corporate actions are involved. The filing is a foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16, incorporated into existing registration statements. As a non-US filer, the Form 6-K serves as a current report equivalent. There are no deal terms, as this is not a special situation.
